analysis.reason: 직전 매수 판단 이후 4일 연속 상승 추세 유지. RSI는 50 이상으로 회복했고 MACD 히스토그램도 개선되며 바닥을 다지고 있다. 5일 저가($174.14)가 20일 저가($174.14)보다 높거나 같아 Higher Low 패턴이 확인되었다.
analysis.reasonEn: The uptrend has been maintained for 4 consecutive days since the previous buy signal. RSI has recovered above 50 and the MACD histogram is improving, building a base. A Higher Low pattern is confirmed as the 5-day low ($174.14) is equal to the 20-day low ($174.14).

· 스윙 지지선 ($181.00) — SMA50 및 20일 저가 기반

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($202.54) vs SMA5/20/50 ($183.47/$192.25/$181.40) — trading above short- and mid-term trends.
· High position relative to SMA100/200 ($146.95/$132.65) — confirming strong mid- to long-term trend.
· 52-week position (88.7%) + current price range near historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (47.2→54.3) — exiting oversold and consolidating in neutral territory.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-2.9632→-2.1623) — improving from bearish convergence, signaling base building.
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band $192.25) — trading around the mid-band, normal band width.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($181.00) — based on SMA50 and 20-day low.
· Swing resistance ($196.41) — breakout to strengthen uptrend.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low) — diagnosing strengthening uptrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.07x) — normal confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (uptrend) — buy entry zone.
analysis.patternNote: 5일 저가와 20일 저가가 동일하여 명확한 Higher Low 패턴을 형성하며 상승 추세가 강화되고 있다.

Uptrend strengthened by the completion of a Higher Low pattern.
